reviews.text: For the third year in a row, we celebrated our baby's birthday with one of your cakes, and Rocket truly loves them with all his heart! 🥹💗 He also loves the banana cookies and turkey brownies—he loves everything! It's become such a lovely tradition for us, and we're so happy to share these moments with you. Thank you for putting so much love into what you do and for being part of our furry friend's most beautiful memories. 🐶🎂💕
Our dog loved it 😋, we ordered it via WhatsApp and picked it up without any problems. Excellent service! …
Thank you so much ♥️♥️
Adorable cakes for dogs, and superb service. Don't forget to buy the little hats, they're the best!

They truly offer exceptional service, they take into account dogs' food allergies, and the cake designs are exactly as shown online. In my case, I made a mistake and ordered it a day later than I needed, and they were incredibly kind and made the cake for me that day! My dog ​​loved her cake!! This is the second year I've ordered a cake for Makka, and once again, the service, flavor, and delivery were excellent.
♥️Thank you so much

I’d like to recommend Barkday Cakes for any occasion when you want to celebrate your pet! My dogs are my children, and today is one of their birthdays. I’m usually much more prepared with a cake, cookie, or cupcake, but I definitely procrastinated this year.

I messaged the bakery, and they were able to have a cake ready the very same day. My Spanish is pretty terrible, but the young woman at the store was incredibly patient as we communicated through Google Translate.

I ended up with the cutest cake for my pup, and the price was very reasonable. I’m so grateful they helped make her birthday special, even with my last-minute request!

This is the second time I've picked up a cake and the same problem has occurred. About an hour after delivery, they called to tell me they forgot to give me something I had already paid for. I appreciate the apology, but it's a recurring mistake that's causing frustration. They should double-check orders before delivery to avoid these kinds of situations.

The cakes are good quality, but the delivery process needs improvement.
Thank you so much for the Kemba cake! All the guests loved it.
Thank you so much

My dad was thrilled with the flavor, the price is quite reasonable for the special occasion, plus they're open every day and you can order a day in advance. They're incredibly helpful from the first contact to delivery. I definitely recommend the Plaza Santa Teresa branch.
Congratulations! One of my dogs is incredibly picky, eating a whole cake without any ill effects. This proves the product is not only beautiful but also of excellent quality.

I loved the attention and service! I ordered cupcakes for my Pewia Zoe the day before her birthday, and they were able to make them for me (it was something simple but truly beautiful) 🎂✨🐾
I was afraid my pet wouldn't like them, but she loved them! She ate the cupcakes and the cookies 🤍🤍
I ordered salmon flavored so the smell would be more appealing to her.

I definitely recommend them and would order again 🎂✨
Thank you so much, Maca is a #1 fan of Barkday Cakes ♥️

Of course, I didn't have time to get them changed because it was already my celebration.
The frosting hardened completely three hours later.
The owner apologized for her employees' poor work, but they ruined my day.
I don't recommend them. 👎🏻
Kai was very happy with his cake, the decoration was super cute

Terrible product and service. We were treated very rudely. If we asked anything, one of the three women would answer in an obviously rude manner, as if she didn't want to make a sale. Once we had paid, the same woman, because she wasn't paying attention, wouldn't let us take what we had bought, holding the cupcakes tightly and asking the cashier if we had already paid, as if we were trying to steal her 80-peso cupcakes. In short, we received terrible treatment, and all of this resulted in the two dogs we gave the cupcakes to getting sick; both had stomach aches and were feeling unwell. I won't be back, and I don't recommend this place.
Excellent pet cakes, made with healthy ingredients and beautifully presented!

The concept, design, and product quality are top-notch. Even the birthday hats are the cutest. Order fulfillment is good, but the in-store service could be better. I've ordered products more than three times, both through custom orders on Instagram and by visiting the store, and I don't know if it's bad timing arriving after work around 6:30 PM, if they're tired, or if they had a bad day at work, but the service at the register has been rude; neither of the two girls has been friendly.
Excellent service for shopping for your furry friends, attentive at all times, my dog ​​loved it! This is my second time buying from them and it definitely won't be the last! ✨

The cake was beautiful, and the service was outstanding. I called them on a Saturday at 5 pm, just 30 minutes before closing time. I transferred the payment and sent a Didi driver to pick up the cake, and it was wonderful. It was truly a great experience. The dogs loved it and even had my dog's name and age written on it. I absolutely love this place. Highly recommended!
Excellent service! And the furry ones loved it!

Highly recommended!!! Excellent service and customer care, plus the quality is amazing! They helped me prepare the cake and birthday package for my kitten Chipotle, who turned one. Everything was completely personalized, fast, and they communicated perfectly. I loved everything, and my kitten and his "cousins" also loved the salmon and tuna cake. I will definitely continue to use this shop to celebrate my babies' birthdays in the future. Thank you, Barkday Cakes!!! You made Chipotle and me the happiest!
My little one loved it! We ordered the carrot and apple one and she really enjoyed it!! The quality and price were excellent, and the decoration was super cute. We'll definitely be back.

We love your products; the quality is evident, and my dogs love them. I used to buy them elsewhere, and they wouldn't even eat them. Thank you for making it possible for us to celebrate with delicious and nutritious treats—and I must say, beautiful creations!

I absolutely do not recommend them. When I made my purchase, I noticed they use Great Value regular peanut butter, which contains added sugars and hydrogenated vegetable oil. The cashier told me they only used a small amount, but as a veterinarian, I know the damage it causes. It's a disaster for dogs; neither the confectionery nor the ingredients are healthy. For the price versus the quality of the ingredients, it's better to give them a cooked piece of meat.
